review_scope: source-only historical R5; no cargo, native MCP, SSH fixtures, deployment, commits or live credentials read

p1_findings.finding: V10 stored a public domain-prefixed SHA256 of full RuntimeConfig in each plaintext binding. Candidate hidden config fields can be checked offline if remaining config is known; this is an oracle rather than raw disclosure.
p1_findings.implementation: For V10 only, derive an independent policy key from the verified credential; HMAC bounded canonical full RuntimeConfig, pass crypto into cancel and all lookups. Preserve V9 DTO behavior.
p1_findings.meaningful_regression: Same policy/same credential stable; changed policy or credential differs; policy binding differs from request/idempotency domains and legacy/plain SHA; input is bounded; all four interfaces use private policy.
p1_findings.status: Historical source issue; fix independently inspected in current source.

p1_findings.finding: read_json validated file once but did not verify same-FD metadata after read. In-place content/mode/link mutation during admission was not rejected as a changed snapshot.
p1_findings.implementation: Bound read and compare same-FD dev/ino/uid/mode/nlink/len/mtime/ctime before/after; revalidate private regular single-link owned0600 file; deserialize only after validation.
p1_findings.meaningful_regression: Deterministic after-read hook injects mode change, same-width content/time change, append and added hardlink; all refuse before lookup/admission authority.
p1_findings.status: Historical source issue; fix independently inspected in current source.

p1_findings.finding: The biased cancellation branch appeared before the operation branch, so an already-ready original SDK result could be discarded when cancellation was also ready.
p1_findings.implementation: Poll completed native result first, preserving original bytes, while keeping pending read futures cancellable and settlement outside the cancellable select.
p1_findings.meaningful_regression: A ready original SDK payload with an already-cancelled token survives byte-for-byte; pending read yields cancelled future with no fake payload; timeout remains unknown.
p1_findings.status: Historical source issue; fix independently inspected in current source.

boundaries.statement: Credential authentication is startup-cached. Token or policy file changes require a controller restart. No live file-reload revocation was tested or inferred.

Key strength requires a sufficiently unpredictable private configured credential. Printable32-byte validation does not establish entropy; no credential guessing or live token inspection was performed.
This is a credential/session scope, not ChatGPT user, conversation or tenant isolation; users sharing a credential share retrieval.
